skill.name: zach-sif-cvr-threshold-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze local Amazon ASIN business reports and SIF daily keyword rank data to find CVR warning thresholds. The skill outputs observation, danger, and advertising CVR confirmation lines for manual review.
skill.summary: Find CVR warning lines that correlate with Amazon organic rank movement.
skill.author: zach22-1999

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, relative README links, XML namespace strings, test temp directories, and normal XML parsing. The confirmed risks are unbounded local XLSX archive parsing and unsanitized output filename components that may allow unintended file writes. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Validate analysis date, site, and ASIN with strict allowlists. Reject absolute paths, path separators, and resolved output paths outside the output directory.
Check workbook file size, zip entry count, and uncompressed XML sizes before reading. Fail with a clear error when limits are exceeded.

remediation.issue: Broad agent tool use for a data analysis workflow
remediation.suggestion: Limit Bash use to the bundled analyzer command and limit writes to the selected output directory. Ask the user before repairing files.

content.user_title: Analyze CVR Risk Lines for Amazon Ranking
content.value_statement: Offsite traffic can lower CVR before organic rank movement appears. This skill aligns business reports with SIF rank data and outputs practical CVR warning lines.
actual_capabilities: Reads local CSV, XLSX, or XLSM business reports with ASIN 360 field aliases.
Reads a local SIF daily keyword rank JSON cache.
Aligns dates, CVR metrics, sessions, and keyword rank changes.
Calculates observation, danger, and advertising CVR confirmation lines.
Writes Markdown, CSV, and stable-keyword JSON analysis outputs.
limitations: Requires a local SIF cache; it does not call SIF services directly.
Needs continuous daily business data for reliable threshold backtesting.
Small windows under 21 days are flagged as weak evidence.
Results are correlation signals, not Amazon algorithm rules.

use_cases.title: Monitor Offsite Traffic Quality
use_cases.description: Check whether offsite campaigns are lowering CVR before key organic ranks move.

use_cases.title: Review Launch Risk Signals
use_cases.description: Backtest launch-period CVR data against SIF keyword movement before changing traffic plans.

use_cases.title: Prepare Rank Risk Reports
use_cases.description: Create a daily panel, threshold candidates, and a written report for stakeholder review.

prompt_templates.title: Run the Sample Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation with included sample files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use zach-sif-cvr-threshold-analyzer with the included sample files. Show the report path and the three CVR lines.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One ASIN
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard analysis with user-provided local files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my target ASIN with this business report and this SIF JSON cache. Use my launch date and core keywords.

prompt_templates.title: Check Data Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Data quality review before running the threshold model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my business report and SIF cache for missing dates, required fields, and small-sample risks before analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Threshold Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for monitoring policy decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the observation, danger, and ad CVR confirmation lines. Explain which line should guide daily monitoring.

output_examples.input: Sample ASIN business report plus SIF daily keyword cache.
output: A Markdown report with observation, danger, and advertising CVR confirmation lines.
A daily CSV panel that aligns sessions, CVR, and rank movement events.
A candidate-threshold CSV showing hit rate, recall, and lift.

output_examples.input: A report with missing SIF days and fewer than 21 days of history.
output_examples.output: The report is generated with concerns about missing SIF dates and weak sample size.

output_examples.input: A business report where natural CVR includes negative adjustment days.
output_examples.output: The analysis flags those dates and avoids using natural CVR as the main monitoring metric.

best_practices: Use one ASIN per run and confirm core keywords manually when possible.
Export a continuous daily window that covers pre-launch and launch periods.
Review threshold actions manually before changing budget, price, promotion, or listing content.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the output as an Amazon official ranking threshold.
Do not mix multiple ASINs in one business report analysis.
Do not continue when required fields or SIF dates are missing.

faq.question: Does this skill call a private SIF service?
faq.answer: No. It reads a local SIF JSON cache created by the user or their tooling.

faq.question: Which report formats are supported?
faq.answer: The analyzer supports CSV, XLSX, and XLSM business reports with compatible daily ASIN fields.

faq.question: What are the three CVR lines?
faq.answer: They are observation, danger, and advertising CVR confirmation lines for manual monitoring.

faq.question: Can it change advertising budgets or listings?
faq.answer: No. It only produces analysis files and recommendations for human review.

faq.question: How much data is needed?
faq.answer: The skill can run on small windows, but fewer than 21 days is marked as weak evidence.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
